en.myth: PCOS means you can't get pregnant.
en.fact: Many people with PCOS/PMOS conceive. Some need medical support, which a doctor can discuss.

en.myth: Only women with higher weight get PCOS.
en.fact: It happens across all body sizes.

en.myth: PCOS is about cysts on the ovaries.
en.fact: The "cysts" are small follicles and many people don't have them. That's one reason it was renamed PMOS in 2026.

en.myth: Irregular periods in teenagers always mean PCOS.
en.fact: Irregular cycles are common in the first years after periods start. A doctor looks at the bigger picture over time.
It can also affect skin, hair, metabolism, and mood.
Symptoms can be managed. A doctor can explain options that fit you.
